understanding the mechanisms of neural computation in the brain.
understanding the neural code for space in the mammalian brain and how this code may be implemented by neural circuits.
understanding how the brain solves spatial tasks, and how it represents space.

the grid-like spatial response properties are a natural solution given the recurrent connections in the brain, and that these spatial representations may be used for navigation.
